about: The offer of an add-on for Koona's checked list, as Koona's add-ons board reads it, written from the board's own code. An offer is an open issue of repository that carries label. Its body has a heading (### and the label) for each field, matched without regard to case, and the value below it, with the white space at both ends trimmed; _No response_ is an empty field. A field is cleaned as cleaned says, then must match pattern (a JavaScript regular expression), be no longer than maxLength and not match notPattern. The board makes no button of an offer whose field breaks its shape, or that leaves a required one empty.
label: submission

fields.label: Repository
fields.cleaned: Slashes at the end and then a ".git" at the end are taken off.

fields.label: Folder
fields.cleaned: A "./" or "/" at the start and slashes at the end are taken off; empty is the repository's root. No part may be "..".
